parts.text: Editorial lifestyle photograph in an Indian metro station concourse or modern office lobby. One young Indian man, about 25–28, smart casual (open-collar shirt, no logos), standing relaxed and holding a phone in his right hand at chest height, glancing at it with a small genuine smile; the phone screen is blank and dark. Soft daylight from tall windows on the right, one consistent direction, even and clean. He stands left of centre; the concourse recedes on the right. Natural skin, correct hands. No text, no signage, no lettering, no logos, no numerals anywhere in the image.
